name: The Cove Phase 2 By Emaar
overview: Developer The Cove 2 is Emaar Properties' latest luxurious development, bringing a sophisticated lifestyle to the waterfront at Dubai Creek Harbour. This premier project offers an exceptional collection of meticulously designed residences, including 1 to 3-bedroom apartments, 2 to 4-bedroom townhouses, and spacious duplexes. Nestled on Creek Island, this multi-storey development combines modern elegance with unmatched comfort and scenic waterfront views, offering a truly upscale living experience.
